annotations.title: See the quotes of a number

description: Lists the quotes of the workspace’s WhatsApp numbers, newest first, one page at a time. Each belongs to one number and one customer, and has its quote number, status, lines (product or custom line, quantity, price), discount, tax, total, deposit, the date it is valid until, and the answers to the number’s quote questions read from the chat. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

conversation_id.description: Only the quotes of this chat.

follow_up.description: due: the sent quotes to follow up today (day 2 or day 5 with no answer).

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

status.description: draft, sent, accepted, declined or expired.

name: list_quotes
title: See the quotes of a number
